remark: The `UnsupportedOperationException` will be thrown if either `sysadmins` or `allowedToCreate` is an unmodifiable list (e.g., created via `Collections.unmodifiableList()` or `Arrays.asList()` which returns a fixed-size list that does not support structural modifications like `clear`).
